summary: The customer has had no hot water at all since this morning from a gas water heater about twelve years old, and wants it looked at today.

job_type.quote: we got no hot water this morning, none at all

urgency.quote: we'd really like it looked at today if you can
urgency.why: The customer asks for today and has no hot water.

ask_first: How many times does the light at the bottom blink before it pauses?
What make and model is the heater, and what size is the tank? It should be on the label on the side.
What is the house number on Pippin Court?
notes: The customer says he sees no leaks and smells nothing.
The heater is a gas one and about twelve years old by his estimate, so replacement may come up as well as repair.
He gives his name as Walt Brennan and says a guest is arriving tonight. This is a transcribed voicemail, so names may be misspelled.
